prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling shipyard dock. On the far left, a rusted anchor rests heavily on the wooden planks, its metal surface textured with age. Next to the anchor stands a tall woman in a yellow raincoat, her posture rigid as she points toward the horizon. Beside her, a small boy in blue overalls looks at the distant cranes, his hand gripping the hem of her coat. In the center foreground, a large crate sits open, revealing coiled ropes inside. A mechanic in greasy coveralls leans against this crate, wiping sweat from his brow with a rag. Perched atop the crate is a seagull with ruffled feathers, watching the activity below with keen interest. To the right of the mechanic, a brown dog sits patiently, its tail thumping softly against the wood. The dog is next to a stack of empty barrels, one of which has a faded stripe. Behind these figures, a massive ship hull looms, its steel plates riveted and imposing. A foreman in a hard hat stands near the hull, handing a clipboard to a worker in a striped shirt who reaches out to take it. The worker in the striped shirt looks at the foreman intently. There is no water visible in the frame, focusing entirely on the dry dock structures. There is no sky depicted, keeping the viewer's attention grounded on the industrial elements and human activity. The composition relies on the interplay of line and subtle hue to define the space without overwhelming detail.
